_comment: Remote accelerator - Out of Range Time Verification, OUT-OF-RANGE pulse - STP 8.5.5.1: drive J2-68 (remote accelerator sensor input). Pulse: period 2.0 s, width 1.05 s (1050 ms, exceeds the valid window to trigger the out-of-range fault), high 5.0 V, low 0.75 V, high-Z. STP runs this as a MANUAL single pulse - configure it, then drive one pulse (output_on / output_off) and capture. Output stays OFF until output_on. Plain numbers in native units: pulse_rate/pulse_width in SECONDS, voltages in V, impedance in ohms (or "INFinity").
name: remote_accel_pulse_1050ms
